BiblicalUsage: Dalphon was a son of Haman, named once among the ten sons who were hanged with their father after the plot against the Jews failed. His name survives only in the list of the judged.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list is there to show that God finishes what He starts: the house that plotted murder fell by its own design.
